note.zh: 关键参数与签名整理自官方手册，讲解文字与示例为本站原创。沙盒已支持的条目可直接运行；标注「沙盒」的差异以 Archicad 实际运行为准。
note.en: Signatures follow the official reference; explanations and examples are original. Entries supported by the sandbox run as-is; sandbox notes mark where behaviour is simplified.

desc.zh: 以当前坐标原点为一个角点，向 +X、+Y、+Z 方向生成长方体。三个参数都必须是正数。
desc.en: Creates a rectangular block with one corner at the current origin, extending towards +X, +Y and +Z. All three sizes must be positive.

desc.zh: 圆柱体：底面圆心在原点，向 +Z 方向长到高度 h。第一个参数是高度不是半径。
desc.en: A cylinder whose base circle is centred at the origin, growing to height h along +Z. The first argument is height, not radius.

desc.zh: 球心在原点、半径为 r 的球体。
desc.en: A sphere centred at the origin with radius r.

zh: r2 — 顶半径（0 即尖顶）
en: r2 — top radius (0 makes a point)

desc.zh: 圆台：底面圆心在原点，沿 +Z 长到 h。顶半径写 0 就是圆锥；顶半径大于 0 是截头圆锥。
desc.en: A truncated cone with its base circle at the origin, growing to height h. Set r2 to 0 for a pointed cone.

zh: h — 竖向总高（Z 向直径）

desc.zh: 椭球体，中心在原点。三个半径互不相等时得到三轴椭球；改 ry 等于 rx 就退化成回转椭球。
desc.en: An ellipsoid centred at the origin. Making ry equal to rx gives a surface of revolution.

commands.name: PRISM
commands.syntax: PRISM n, h, x1, y1, s1, … , xn, yn, sn

zh: xi, yi — 第 i 个顶点坐标
si — 顶点状态码：1 起点、0 中间点、-1 终点
en: si — vertex status: 1 first, 0 intermediate, -1 last

desc.zh: 把 XY 平面上的闭合多边形沿 +Z 挤出成柱体。参数必须一次给全，换行用续行（行尾逗号）。这是做异形截面的主力命令。
desc.en: Extrudes a closed XY polygon up the Z axis. All vertices must be supplied in one statement (continue lines with a trailing comma). The workhorse for non-rectangular sections.

commands.name: PRISM_
commands.syntax: PRISM_ n, h, x1, y1, s1, … , xn, yn, sn, …

zh: n — 轮廓与洞口的顶点总数
si — 状态码（1/-1/0，洞口用负状态码段）
en: n — total vertices of contour and holes
si — status codes (1/-1/0; holes use negative segments)

desc.zh: PRISM 的增强版，支持多个轮廓与洞口（把带洞的截面一次挤出）。沙盒目前按单轮廓处理，洞口请以 Archicad 为准。
desc.en: The extended form of PRISM supporting multiple contours and holes. The sandbox currently handles a single contour; verify holes in Archicad.

commands.name: EXTRUDE
commands.syntax: EXTRUDE n, dx, dy, dz, mask, x1, y1, s1, … , xn, yn, sn

zh: dx, dy, dz — 挤出向量（三个分量不能全为 0）
mask — 端面/侧面可见性掩码
si — 顶点状态码：1 起点、0 中间点、-1 终点
en: dx, dy, dz — extrusion vector (not all zero)
si — vertex status: 1 first, 0 intermediate, -1 last

desc.zh: 把截面沿任意方向的向量挤出，是 PRISM（只能沿 +Z）的通用版。截面仍在 x-y 平面，挤出方向由向量决定，做斜向挑檐、坡道、斜撑最顺手。沙盒忽略 mask，零向量会报错。
desc.en: Extrudes a profile along an arbitrary vector — the general form of PRISM, which can only go up +Z. The profile stays in the x-y plane while the vector sets the direction; ideal for slanted canopies, ramps and braces. The sandbox ignores mask and rejects a zero vector.

commands.name: REVOLVE
commands.syntax: REVOLVE n, alpha, mask, x1, y1, s1, … , xn, yn, sn

zh: alpha — 旋转角度（度，可负；不能为 0）
mask — 端面/侧面可见性掩码
xi, yi — 截面顶点，yi 必须 ≥ 0（就是半径）
si — 顶点状态码：1 起点、0 中间点、-1 终点
en: alpha — sweep angle in degrees (may be negative, not zero)
xi, yi — profile vertices; yi must be ≥ 0 (it is the radius)
si — vertex status: 1 first, 0 intermediate, -1 last

desc.zh: 截面绕 X 轴旋转成回转体：截面画在 x-y 平面，x 是轴向位置、y 是半径，y 不能为负。做柱础、花瓶、圆角线脚最省事；想让轴线立起来，先 `ROT 0, 90, 0`。沙盒忽略 mask，非整周时自动补端盖。
desc.en: Revolves a profile around the X axis: draw it in the x-y plane where x is the axial position and y the radius (never negative). Great for column bases, vases and mouldings; add `ROT 0, 90, 0` first to stand the axis up. The sandbox ignores mask and caps partial sweeps.

zh: dx, dy, dz — 沿三个轴的平移量
en: dx, dy, dz — offsets along the three axes

desc.zh: 把当前坐标系平移到新位置并压栈。后续几何都相对于新原点。用完记得 DEL 回退。
desc.en: Translates the current coordinate system and pushes it on the stack. Later geometry is relative to the new origin; pop it with DEL when done.

desc.zh: 等价于 `ADD dx, 0, 0` 的简写。ADDY / ADDZ 同理。
desc.en: Shorthand for `ADD dx, 0, 0`; ADDY / ADDZ work the same way.

desc.zh: 等价于 `ADD 0, dy, 0`。
desc.en: Equivalent to `ADD 0, dy, 0`.

desc.zh: 等价于 `ADD 0, 0, dz`。
desc.en: Equivalent to `ADD 0, 0, dz`.

commands.name: ROT

zh: x, y, z — 绕三个轴的旋转角（度）
en: x, y, z — rotation angles in degrees

desc.zh: 按 X → Y → Z 的顺序旋转当前坐标系并压栈。角度用度不是弧度；连续 ROT 会层层叠加，容易转乱，建议每轮做完就 DEL。
desc.en: Rotates the current coordinate system in X → Y → Z order and pushes it. Angles are degrees; consecutive ROT calls accumulate, so pop with DEL each round.

commands.example:
FOR i = 1 TO 6
  ROT 0, 0, i * 60
  ADD 1.2, 0, 0
  BLOCK 0.2, 0.1, 0.5
  DEL 2
NEXT i

zh: angle — 绕 X 轴角度（度）

desc.zh: 只绕 X 轴旋转，等价于 `ROT angle, 0, 0`。
desc.en: Rotate around X only; same as `ROT angle, 0, 0`.

zh: angle — 绕 Y 轴角度（度）

desc.zh: 只绕 Y 轴旋转，等价于 `ROT 0, angle, 0`。
desc.en: Rotate around Y only; same as `ROT 0, angle, 0`.

zh: angle — 绕 Z 轴角度（度）

desc.zh: 只绕 Z 轴旋转，平面阵列排版最常用。
desc.en: Rotate around Z only; the usual choice for radial layouts.

zh: sx, sy, sz — 三个轴的比例因子
en: sx, sy, sz — scale factors per axis

desc.zh: 对当前坐标系做非等比缩放并压栈。它改的是「单位」不是「尺寸」——之后所有坐标（包括 ADD 的位移）都会被一起缩放。
desc.en: Scales the current coordinate system and pushes it. It changes the unit, so every later coordinate (including ADD offsets) is scaled too.

desc.zh: 等价于 `MUL sx, 1, 1`。
desc.en: Equivalent to `MUL sx, 1, 1`.

desc.zh: 等价于 `MUL 1, sy, 1`。
desc.en: Equivalent to `MUL 1, sy, 1`.

desc.zh: 等价于 `MUL 1, 1, sz`。
desc.en: Equivalent to `MUL 1, 1, sz`.

zh: n — 回退的层数；省略则退 1 层；`DEL TOP` 退到栈底
en: n — levels to pop; omitted means 1; `DEL TOP` clears to the root

desc.zh: 变换栈出栈，恢复到 n 层之前的坐标系。每个 ADD/ROT/MUL 都要配一个 DEL，否则出错是必然的。
desc.en: Pops n levels from the transformation stack. Every ADD/ROT/MUL needs a matching DEL; forgetting them is the most common source of wrong geometry.

desc.zh: 在 2D 脚本里从 (x1,y1) 到 (x2,y2) 画一条直线。2D 坐标 y 向上，单位与 3D 一致。
desc.en: Draws a line from (x1,y1) to (x2,y2) in the 2D script. The 2D y axis points up; units match the 3D script.

desc.zh: 用两个对角点画矩形。平面符号里最省事的轮廓画法。
desc.en: Draws a rectangle from two opposite corners; the quickest outline for a plan symbol.

desc.zh: 画整圆。四条腿的桌子在平面图上就是四个圆。
desc.en: Draws a full circle; a four-legged table becomes four circles in plan.

commands.name: ARC2
commands.syntax: ARC2 x, y, r, a1, a2

desc.zh: 画圆弧，从 a1 逆时针到 a2。角度用度，0° 指向 +X。
desc.en: Draws an arc from a1 counter-clockwise to a2, in degrees, with 0° pointing along +X.

desc.zh: 在平面符号上写字。字号、对齐由后续属性命令控制，沙盒只画内容不还原字体。
desc.en: Places text in the plan symbol. Size and alignment come from attribute commands; the sandbox renders the content only.

commands.name: POLY2_
commands.syntax: POLY2_ n, fill, x1, y1, s1, … , xn, yn, sn

zh: fill — 填充索引（0 为不填充）
si — 顶点状态码（1 起、0 中、-1 止）
en: si — status codes (1 start, 0 mid, -1 end)

desc.zh: 一次画出带填充属性的多边形，是平面符号做异形轮廓的主力。
desc.en: Draws a polygon with a fill attribute in one statement; the main tool for irregular plan outlines.

commands.name: HOTSPOT2
commands.syntax: HOTSPOT2 x, y [, unID [, paramRef [, flags [, displayParam [, "desc"]]]]]

zh: x, y — 热点坐标（2D 符号空间）
unID — 热点编号，同一对象内唯一；沙盒只接受前两个参数
paramRef — 该热点可拖动的参数名
flags — 类型 + 属性：类型 1 基准点 / 2 移动点 / 3 参考点（长度编辑），4~7 为角度编辑；属性 128 隐藏、256 基准点可拖
displayParam — 信息面板里显示的参数，可写数组元素如 Arr[5]
"desc" — 信息面板里的自定义说明，必须同时给 displayParam
en: x, y — hotspot position in 2D symbol space
unID — unique ID inside the object; the sandbox accepts only the first two arguments
paramRef — parameter that this hotspot edits by dragging
flags — type + attribute: 1 base / 2 moving / 3 reference (length), 4~7 for angle editing; attribute 128 hides it, 256 makes the base draggable
displayParam — parameter shown in the info palette; array members such as Arr[5] are allowed
"desc" — custom description in the info palette; requires displayParam

desc.zh: 在 2D 符号上定义热点（编辑点），本身不画图形，是「拖动改尺寸」的抓手。长度编辑必须凑齐三个点：基准 (1)、移动 (2)、参考 (3)，参数值等于基准到移动点的距离，正方向由参考点指向基准点。沙盒只接受 x, y 两个参数且不显示热点。
desc.en: Defines an editable hotspot in the plan symbol — no geometry, just a handle for dragging a parameter. Length editing needs three matched points: base (1), moving (2) and reference (3); the value is the distance from base to moving, positive towards the reference-to-base direction. The sandbox accepts x, y only and draws nothing.

commands.example:
HOTSPOT2 0, 0, 3, corner_y, 1 + 128
HOTSPOT2 0, -1, 4, corner_y, 3
HOTSPOT2 0, corner_y, 5, corner_y, 2

zh: x, y, z — 3D 空间点坐标
en: x, y, z — a point in 3D space

desc.zh: 把 3D 点按当前投影方式投到平面图上，自动跟随平面图旋转（PROJECT2 常与 GLOB 结合用）。沙盒不绘制投影结果。
desc.en: Projects a 3D point into the plan using the current projection, so the symbol follows the plan rotation. The sandbox does not draw projected output.

desc.zh: 2D 变换栈的平移，只影响后续 2D 图形，不影响 3D。
desc.en: Translates the 2D transformation stack; affects later 2D shapes only.

desc.zh: 旋转 2D 坐标系。做斜向布置的平面符号很方便。
desc.en: Rotates the 2D coordinate system; handy for angled plan symbols.

desc.zh: 2D 非等比缩放，常用于把同一套符号拉伸适配不同尺寸。
desc.en: Non-uniform 2D scaling, useful for stretching one symbol to different sizes.

desc.zh: 2D 变换栈出栈，和 3D 的 DEL 分开管理，互不干扰。
desc.en: Pops the 2D transformation stack; independent from the 3D stack.

desc.zh: 给后续几何体指定材质索引，索引对应 Archicad 项目里的材质表。沙盒用固定调色板近似显示，颜色与真实材质不一致。
desc.en: Assigns a material index to following geometry, referring to the project's material table. The sandbox uses a fixed palette, so colours differ from Archicad.

desc.zh: 指定后续线条使用的画笔颜色。3D 里控制轮廓线，2D 里控制线型颜色。
desc.en: Selects the pen colour for subsequent lines: contour edges in 3D, line colour in 2D.

commands.name: IF

zh: condition — 条件表达式（非 0 为真）

desc.zh: 块式或单行式条件分支。相等判断写 `=`，不是 `==`；比较可用 `<>`、`<`、`>`、`<=`、`>=`，并用 AND / OR 组合。
desc.en: Block or single-line conditional. Equality is `=`, not `==`; comparisons support `<>`, `<`, `>`, `<=`, `>=`, combined with AND / OR.

commands.example:
IF h > 1.0 THEN
  BLOCK 1, 1, h
ELSE
  BLOCK 1, 1, 1.0
ENDIF

commands.name: FOR
commands.syntax: FOR v = from TO to [STEP s] … NEXT [v]

desc.zh: 次数已知的循环。循环结束后变量仍保留（值为越过上限的第一个值），后面继续用要重新赋值。
desc.en: A counted loop. The variable survives after the loop with the first value past the limit, so re-initialise before reuse.

commands.example:
FOR i = 1 TO 4
  ADD 0.3, 0, 0
  BLOCK 0.05, 0.05, 0.7
  DEL 1
NEXT i

commands.name: WHILE

zh: condition — 循环条件（非 0 继续）

desc.zh: 条件为真就继续。必须在循环体里自己改条件变量，否则死循环；沙盒有 10000 次保险丝，真实 Archicad 会卡死。
desc.en: Loops while the condition holds. You must update the condition variable yourself; the sandbox has a 10000-iteration fuse, real Archicad simply hangs.

commands.example:
z = 0
WHILE z < 1.8
  ADD 0, 0, z
  BLOCK 0.9, 0.3, 0.02
  DEL 1
  z = z + 0.4
ENDWHILE

commands.name: GOSUB

zh: label — 子程序入口标签名
en: label — entry label of the subroutine

desc.zh: 跳到标签处执行子程序，遇到 RETURN 回到调用点。标签写在行首，后面加冒号：`build_leg:`。
desc.en: Jumps to a labelled subroutine and returns at RETURN. Write the label at line start followed by a colon: `build_leg:`.

commands.example:
GOSUB draw_leg
END

draw_leg:
  CYLIND 0.7, 0.03
RETURN

commands.name: RETURN

desc.zh: 从子程序返回调用点。没有对应 GOSUB 时执行 RETURN 会报错，也常被用来给主脚本收尾。
desc.en: Returns from a subroutine. A RETURN without a matching GOSUB raises an error and is often used to finish the main script.

commands.example:
GOSUB draw_leg
END

draw_leg:
  CYLIND 0.7, 0.03
RETURN

desc.zh: 立即结束脚本，不再执行后面的行。子程序通常放在 END 之后，避免主流程执行时误入。
desc.en: Stops the script immediately. Put subroutines after END so the main flow cannot fall into them.

zh: name — 组名字符串，同一脚本内不能重复
en: name — group name string, unique within the script

desc.zh: 把一对 GROUP / ENDGROUP 之间的实体打包成一个可运算的组，供 SUBGROUP、ADDGROUP、ISECTGROUP 使用。组本身不出现在模型里，必须 PLACEGROUP 才落位。组不能嵌套，组内变换不影响组外。沙盒暂不支持。
desc.en: Packs all bodies between GROUP and ENDGROUP into an operable group for SUBGROUP, ADDGROUP or ISECTGROUP. The group is not placed automatically — call PLACEGROUP. Groups cannot be nested, and transforms inside do not leak out. Not supported by the sandbox.

commands.name: SUBGROUP

zh: g_expr2 — 减掉的组（挖去的部分）
en: g_expr2 — tool group that is removed

desc.zh: 布尔差集：从 g_expr1 中减去 g_expr2，返回一个新组。顺序敏感，写反了会得到完全不同的结果。常用于在一块板上挖洞。沙盒暂不支持。
desc.en: Boolean difference: subtracts g_expr2 from g_expr1 and returns a new group. Order matters — swapping the arguments changes the result completely. Typical use: cutting a hole in a board. Not supported by the sandbox.

commands.example:
GROUP "panel"
  BLOCK 0.6, 0.02, 2.0
ENDGROUP
GROUP "hole"
  ADD 0.3, -0.01, 1.2
  ROTX -90
  CYLIND 0.06, 0.03
ENDGROUP
PLACEGROUP SUBGROUP("panel", "hole")

desc.zh: 布尔并集：把两个组合成一个，参数顺序不影响结果。相邻面会被合并，所以两个刚好贴合的体会被当成一个整体。沙盒暂不支持。
desc.en: Boolean union: merges two groups into one; the order does not matter. Touching faces are merged, so two bodies that exactly meet become one. Not supported by the sandbox.

desc.zh: 布尔交集：只保留两个组的重叠部分，顺序不敏感。常用来「用切刀截取一段」。沙盒暂不支持。
desc.en: Boolean intersection: keeps only the overlapping part, order insensitive. Often used to slice a shape with a cutting plane. Not supported by the sandbox.

en: g_expr — group name or group variable

desc.zh: 把组真正生成到模型里。定义 GROUP 只是登记，不写 PLACEGROUP 就什么也看不见，脚本也不会报错。当前的变换和剖切面在这里生效。
desc.en: Generates the group into the model. Defining a GROUP only registers it; without PLACEGROUP nothing appears and no error is raised. Current transforms and cut planes apply here.

en: g_expr — name of the group to release

desc.zh: 清空并释放组占用的内存。用完的组要立刻释放，否则一直占到脚本结束；释放后组名不能再用。脚本结束或宏返回时也会自动释放。
desc.en: Clears the group and frees its memory. Release groups as soon as they are no longer needed; a killed group name cannot be reused. Everything is released automatically when the script ends or a macro returns.

zh: min, max, step — 数值参数的上下限与步长
"value1", "value2" — 字符串参数的候选值，界面上变下拉
en: param — parameter name as a string
min, max, step — range and step for numeric parameters
"value1", "value2" — candidate strings shown as a dropdown

desc.zh: 参数脚本里限制参数取值：数值给范围与步长，字符串给候选列表。写在 IF 里可以做条件约束（例如窄柜只允许 2 扇门）。沙盒暂不支持参数脚本。
desc.en: Restricts parameter values inside the parameter script: a range and step for numbers, a candidate list for strings. Wrap it in IF for conditional limits (a narrow cabinet allowing only two doors, for instance). The sandbox does not run parameter scripts.

zh: expression — 由其它参数组成的表达式
en: expression — formula built from other parameters

desc.zh: 在参数脚本里把参数设为推导值：每次运行参数脚本都会按表达式重算，界面上的输入框表现为只读。适合做「高 = 宽 × 0.75」这类联动尺寸。
desc.en: Marks a parameter as derived inside the parameter script: it is recomputed from the expression on every run and appears read-only in the dialog. Ideal for linked sizes such as height = width * 0.75.

en: param — parameter name as a string

desc.zh: 在参数脚本里锁住参数，界面上的对应输入框变灰不可编辑，但仍显示在参数列表。用它防止用户改内部参数；要让参数由公式算，用 PARAMETERS。
desc.en: Locks a parameter from the parameter script: its field turns grey and cannot be edited, but it stays visible. Use it for internal values; use PARAMETERS when a formula should drive the value.

zh: ALL — 隐藏全部；后面跟参数名则只保留这些
en: ALL — hide everything; names listed after it stay visible

desc.zh: 把参数从参数列表里彻底隐藏，脚本里仍能读写。适合纯内部的计算参数。被隐藏的参数用户改不了，永远保持默认值，别把需要用户填的参数藏起来。
desc.en: Removes a parameter from the parameter list entirely; scripts can still read and write it. Good for internal calculation values. A hidden parameter keeps its default forever, so never hide something the user must fill in.

zh: array — 数组名，可一次声明多个，用逗号分隔
d1, d2 — 维度长度（数值常量）；留空即动态数组
en: array — array name; several may be declared at once
d1, d2 — dimension sizes (numeric constants); leave empty for a dynamic array

desc.zh: 声明数组。下标从 1 开始，最多两维；`DIM a[]` 为动态数组，赋值时自动扩展。固定长度数组越界会报错并中止脚本；动态数组不做边界检查，越界读到的是垃圾值。长度用 `VARDIM1` / `VARDIM2` 取。
desc.en: Declares an array. Indices start at 1, two dimensions maximum; `DIM a[]` is dynamic and grows on assignment. Fixed-length arrays raise an error on out-of-range access; dynamic arrays are unchecked and return garbage. Read the size with `VARDIM1` / `VARDIM2`.

commands.name: OPEN

zh: filter — Add-On 名称，文本文件填 "TEXT"
parameterString — 传给 Add-On 的参数，如 "SEPARATOR = ',', mode = ro"
mode — ro 只读 / wo 只写并清空 / wa 追加；没有 rw
返回值 — 正数通道号；-1 文件不存在；-2 缺 Add-On
en: filter — Add-On name, "TEXT" for text files
filename — file name, optionally with a path
parameterString — options for the Add-On, e.g. "SEPARATOR = ',', mode = ro"
mode — ro read-only / wo write and truncate / wa append; there is no rw
returns — positive channel; -1 missing file; -2 missing Add-On

desc.zh: 打开外部文件并返回通道号，后续 INPUT / OUTPUT / CLOSE 都用它。必须判返回值是否大于 0，否则文件缺失时后面所有操作都在对不存在的通道说话，而且不会报错。
desc.en: Opens an external file and returns a channel number used by INPUT / OUTPUT / CLOSE. Always test that the value is greater than 0 — otherwise every later call talks to a channel that does not exist, silently.

commands.example:
ch = OPEN ("TEXT", "cabinet.csv", "SEPARATOR = ',', mode = ro")
IF ch > 0 THEN
  ! INPUT ...
  CLOSE ch
ENDIF

commands.name: INPUT
commands.syntax: n = INPUT (channel, recordID, fieldID, var1 [, var2, ...])

zh: channel — OPEN 返回的通道号
recordID, fieldID — 起始记录与字段（文本 Add-On 里是行号与行内字段号，都从 1 起）
var1... — 接收值的变量，类型由文件内容决定
返回值 — 成功读到的个数；-1 表示文件结束
en: recordID, fieldID — starting record and field (text Add-On: line number and field within the line, both 1-based)
var1... — variables receiving the values; types follow the file content
returns — number of values read; -1 at end of file

desc.zh: 从文件按位置读取若干值，是函数不是命令，必须接返回值判断是否到文件尾。读进来的变量可能是数字也可能是字符串，用 VARTYPE 判断后再参与计算。
desc.en: Reads values from the file at a given position. It is a function, not a statement: capture the return value to detect end of file. Values may arrive as numbers or strings — check with VARTYPE before doing arithmetic.

commands.example:
WHILE INPUT (ch, n + 1, 1, code, cw, chh) > 0
  n = n + 1
ENDWHILE

commands.name: OUTPUT
commands.syntax: OUTPUT channel, recordID, fieldID, expr1 [, expr2, ...]

zh: channel — OPEN 返回的通道号
recordID, fieldID — 写入位置；文本 Add-On 只认 recordID 是否变化，变了就换行
expr1... — 要写的值，至少一个
en: recordID, fieldID — write position; the text Add-On only watches whether recordID changes, which starts a new line
expr1... — values to write, at least one

desc.zh: 把值写进文件，是命令语句，不返回值。写表格先写表头再写数据；数字用 STR 转成文本，宽度给足，太窄会输出一串星号。
desc.en: Writes values to the file. This is a statement, it returns nothing. Write the header before the rows; convert numbers with STR and give them enough width, or you get a row of asterisks.

desc.zh: 关闭文件，把缓冲区刷到磁盘。写完立刻关，别拖到脚本末尾；导出中途出错时，文件很可能是残缺的。
desc.en: Closes the file and flushes the buffer to disk. Close right after writing instead of leaving it to the end of the script — an export interrupted midway usually leaves a truncated file.

commands.name: VARTYPE

zh: expression — 要判断类型的变量或表达式
en: expression — variable or expression to inspect

desc.zh: 返回类型编号：1 数值、2 字符串、3 组、4 字典。读文件后先用它判断再计算，避免把字符串当数字用；GDL 不会在编译期拦住类型错误。
desc.en: Returns a type code: 1 number, 2 string, 3 group, 4 dictionary. Use it after reading a file before doing arithmetic — GDL never catches type mismatches at compile time.

commands.example:
IF VARTYPE (v) = 2 THEN
  code = v
ELSE
  code = STR (v, 8, 0)
ENDIF

commands.name: VARDIM1

zh: array — 已声明的一维数组

desc.zh: 取数组第一维的长度。动态数组随用随长，读完文件后用它拿到真实行数；二维数组的第二维长度用 `VARDIM2`。
desc.en: Returns the length of the first dimension. A dynamic array grows as you fill it, so read the real row count with this after loading a file; use `VARDIM2` for the second dimension.

commands.example:
DIM rows[]
! ... fill rows ...
n = VARDIM1 (rows)
